text:
Sanjay: Quick async check on Helix (cloud-north-1) expansion — need a short status/update on inbound+egress routing, KMS/data-residency, and any cutover blockers. We have a soft PI milestone Wed EOD. Who's owning which item?

Priya: I'm taking routing policy. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-infra/helm/pull/412 — contains NetworkPolicy + egress ACLs. I need net infra to validate peering ranges and confirm firewall tag names before I can merge.

Rua: Peering ranges are ready from our side, attached below. Waiting on cloud-team to set firewall tag `helix-internal`. Ticket INF-789 is the request for tag creation.

Rua: ```
VPC ranges: 10.42.0.0/16
Edge egress: 34.120.0.0/14
Peering subnets: 172.31.200.0/22
```

Priya: Thanks Rua. I will update the PR with those exact ranges. Also adding a fallback policy that routes to standard-edge if helix capacity < 10 rps — want to make sure ops is ok with automatic fallback.

Jamal: Runtime note: Helix models need the g5-16x AMI with our kernel patch. AMI bake scheduled for Tue night. If fallback to standard-edge triggers, KV cache compatibility is fine but we lose some prefix-cache benefits (higher cost).

Theo: Security/KMS check: we approved customer-managed KMS for Helix but need a documented rotation plan + key access matrix. Also confirm: no automatic cross-region snapshots for Helix by default (product to confirm). I'll block final approval until rotation policy is in the infra runbook.

Ava: Product: customers asked for 2-year data retention and no cross-region backups by default. We can support optional cross-region DR but must be explicit opt-in. I'll add the two-year retention requirement to the feature spec.

Sanjay: Good — that clarifies product and security constraints. Can someone post short status items like: routing PR, peering ticket, KMS runbook, AMI bake, observability dashboards? I'll consolidate into the rollout checklist.

Rua: Peering ticket INF-789: in progress (owner: Rua), ETA Wed 10:00 UTC. Firewall tag request pending cloud-team.

Priya: Routing PR #412: changeset done, blocked on tag validation. I added a canary flag `helix.canary=true` that the console uses to direct traffic.

Jamal: AMI bake: baking image g5-helix-2026-03-02, smoke tests queued. ETA Tue 23:00 UTC. Also pushing a tiny runtime change to accept the helix kvcache chunk size — PR 589.

Theo: KMS/runbook: drafting rotation doc in https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1122. Will post by EOD Tuesday.

OpsBot: OpsBot: Reminder — please tag deploys with `rollout:helix` and include `residency:cloud-north-1` in incidents/alerts.

Priya: Also pinging infra owners: @Rua @Sanjay — need one approval from cloud-team to merge.

Ava: I added a customer-facing note to the spec: Helix initial availability will not include cross-region backups; DR opt-in timeline TBD.

Sanjay: Action list for rollout doc (short):
- Priya: merge routing PR once tag exists (PR 412)
- Rua: get firewall tag + close INF-789
- Jamal: finish AMI bake + merge runtime PR 589
- Theo: post KMS rotation/runbook SEC-1122
- Ava: finalize spec/residency wording
- Ops: create observability dashboard for Helix latency/cost (ApmDash-helix)

Ava: I can own the spec wording and customer comms.

Rua: I'll chase cloud-team on the tag, will update INF-789 with ETA.

Jamal: I'll post bake logs and template AMI id when ready.

Priya: Once tag exists I'll flip canary and run traffic tests against the canary pool (lightweight load 5 rps).

Sanjay: Great. If anyone hits a hard blocker (KMS keys not provisioned, tag denied, AMI bake failing), drop a ping here and mark escalation. Otherwise I'll take these action owners and assemble a one-pager for the release channel.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR 589 merged to runtime-canary at 1769998000 — smoke pass on x86, awaiting g5 validation. :rocket:

Sanjay: Thanks all — I'll post the compiled checklist when PRs/tickets move. Back to async updates; please keep short status updates here.
